title: Boston Gas Company submits for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with the Trustees of 9 Hawthone Place Condominium Trust.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: Boston Gas Company files responses to the Attorney General's Information and Data Requests. By: Thomas P. O'Neil, Counsel of Boston Gas Company. (GC 00-09)

The Department APPROVES the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms to be purchased under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protecton from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connolly, Chair; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC 00-09)
Attorney General's data and information requests. By: John M. Grugan, Assistant Attorney General. (GC 00-09)
